top_creatures.label: Splitting Ooze
top_creatures.why: one hit makes two bodies that read as a growing cluster at 375 wide
top_creatures.keep: split on hit, halving HP; the clone does not inherit learned abilities
top_creatures.change: exact HP conservation (defect D3 fixed); our own silhouette and splitting sound; engaged pieces capped at three
top_creatures.ref: src/brogue/Globals.c line 1049 (pink jelly), 1092 (acidic), 1129 (black); src/brogue/Combat.c line 273; src/brogue/Monsters.c line 564

top_creatures.label: Gas Bladder
top_creatures.why: slow kamikaze that drifts erratically and bursts into a hazard when it dies or reaches you
top_creatures.change: the burst is a server-verified zone hazard, not a local effect

top_creatures.label: Reed Lurker
top_creatures.why: lives only in water, submerges, and surfaces to strike
top_creatures.change: a surface ripple as a 0.5 s tell before the strike, for 375-wide readability

top_creatures.label: Pilfering Imp
top_creatures.why: hits to steal, then flees with the item; the item comes back when it dies
top_creatures.keep: steal on hit, flee, drop on death
top_creatures.change: steals a consumable from a fight pool, never from the one character ledger

top_creatures.label: Waking Guardian
top_creatures.why: a near-indestructible guardian that moves only when the player acts
top_creatures.keep: turn-on-activation: moves when the player moves
top_creatures.change: activation is a zone-data trigger on the server step count; our own glyph silhouette

top_creatures.label: Soul Vessel Lich
top_creatures.why: a caster with a separate vessel object that is summoned into and can be destroyed
top_creatures.keep: a second object that must die, placed by the zone
top_creatures.change: a destructible shrine object placed by zone data; one server-verified kill rule. Link between lich death and vessel not read

top_creatures.label: Warlord Chanter
top_creatures.why: a boss that keeps distance, summons escort, and attacks with penetrating reach
top_creatures.change: summon count capped by a many-on-one rule plus a falling chance per minion

top_creatures.label: Dread Wyrm
top_creatures.why: apex creature with ranged breath, an all-adjacent sweep and a guaranteed drop
top_creatures.change: breath as a telegraphed cone, readable at 375 wide

weapon_families.note: mace and hammer stagger; flail passes attacks

gear_tiers.label: armour ladder
gear_tiers.technique: six bases with rising strength and armour value; tier shows by base name

gear_tiers.label: weapon enchant roll
gear_tiers.technique: 40 percent enchant roll of 1-3; half cursed; a third of cursed get a bad runic; good runic gated by base damage

gear_tiers.label: runics
gear_tiers.technique: 10 weapon runics (8 good, 2 bad); 11 armour runics (8 good, 3 bad)

gear_tiers.label: unknown appearance
gear_tiers.technique: flavour names shuffled each game; unidentified titles from a phoneme table

gear_tiers.label: lumenstone by depth
gear_tiers.technique: 14 depth-banded counts for a late-game collectible

zones.label: Sentinel sanctuary
zones.technique: support turrets that heal and shock their neighbours; one support type per room

zones.label: Statuary
zones.technique: statues crack and burst into monsters when the key is taken or the player comes near

zones.label: Flood room with eel pools
zones.technique: taking the key floods the room so eels reach you

zones.label: Haunted house
zones.technique: room darkens, ectoplasm covers everything, phantoms appear

looks.label: Death blood per creature

looks.label: Flitting idle motion
looks.technique: erratic move flag on eels, bats, bloats, pixies, phantoms, wisps as the idle read

originals.name: Splitting Ooze
originals.idea: split on hit with shared HP, engaged pieces capped
originals.change: exact HP conservation (defect D3); cap at three engaged, as MAX_ATTACKERS requires. Parity rows 2 and 4

originals.name: Wandering Warband
originals.idea: periodic wandering group on a random fuse; spawns exclude captive, summoned and machine-only groups
originals.keep: random fuse reset of 125-175 environment updates; exclusion filter
originals.change: zone spawn cap with grace timer before despawn; flat-ground siting. Parity row 23

originals.name: Two-Sense Aggro
originals.idea: a monster notices by sight at a probability per tick; loses track at a lower probability beyond awareness; hard drop at three times awareness
originals.keep: 25 percent notice, 3 percent loss, hard drop
originals.change: no scent map; a server trail of the last seen position per zone. Parity rows 2 and 4

originals.name: Captive Guard Camp
originals.idea: a captive leader with guards around it; rescue turns it into an ally
originals.change: rescued captive joins after one engage state change; no per-guard reward. Parity rows 4 and 23

originals.name: Key Altar Trap Room
originals.idea: the key is the reward and taking it springs a room trap
originals.keep: key as reward; trap as consequence
originals.change: one server-verified trigger; our own trap set (flood, gas, statues, crypt). Parity rows 20 and 23

originals.name: One-Pick Cage Library
originals.idea: take one reward; the rest lock; swap back allowed
originals.change: choice is server-side after a Pit win; swap-back has a cooldown. Parity row 18

originals.name: Flee-to-Regroup
originals.idea: flee at or under a quarter HP; return at three quarters HP
originals.change: a rally banner and a sound cue on return. Parity rows 2 and 4

originals.name: Turn-on-Step Guardian
originals.idea: a guardian that moves only when the player acts
originals.change: trigger is the server step count of the player zone tile; our silhouette. Parity rows 4 and 23

originals.name: Item Event Flare
originals.idea: one short light flash keyed to an item event
originals.change: our tint and length. Parity rows 9 and 13
